You are a blind design critic for piece=color-atmosphere round=r1.

Inspect REAL evidence:
- Ours: gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r1/ (dark-home-desktop.png, light-home-desktop.png, dark-home-mobile.png, NOTES.md)
- Bar: gauntlet/bar/*/home-desktop.png and nav/desktop-hero screenshots; WIN_CRITERIA.md if present
- Focus on palette, atmosphere, dark/light craft — not layout ownership of other pieces

Blind A/B without revealing which is ours until after winner pick.

Write ONLY gauntlet/critics/color-atmosphere-r1.md with fields:
piece, round, winner (us|bar|tie), biggest_gap, next_build_instruction, evidence_paths[], blind_ab_note

Harsh. Prefer bar if ours is generic or muddy.
I’m using the caveman skill in ultra mode to inspect the supplied screenshots and produce the blind A/B verdict.

content.text: Evidence read. Candidate A shows cyan/gray drift, broken theme pairing, blank mobile hero; Candidate B has deliberate depth/contrast across multiple bar references. Writing harsh bar-win critic now.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/gauntlet/critics/color-atmosphere-r1.md
+piece: color-atmosphere
+round: r1
+winner: bar
+biggest_gap: Ours has no coherent palette contract in captured output: cyan accent and cold gray wash replace specified amber/warm ink, light and dark screenshots appear swapped, and mobile collapses to near-empty black. Bar examples make atmosphere structural and legible (dai grid, pham symbol field, eftakher red signal) while retaining strong contrast.
+next_build_instruction: Enforce one end-to-end theme contract before recapture—dark #07080b with warm ink surfaces and amber #e8a23a (light #c47e1a), retint every accent/activity cell, add visible grain/grid/vignette depth, then verify both desktop themes and mobile render the same complete hero instead of blank or mismatched states.
+evidence_paths:
+  - gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r1/dark-home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r1/light-home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r1/dark-home-mobile.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/dai-is-a-dev/home-desktop.png

+  - gauntlet/bar/ericsin/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/evilrabbit/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/loganliffick/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/pham-codes/home-desktop.png
